name: Ecotrons ALM-CAN (J1939)
note: Every lambda field arrives UNSET, which is the point: set a lambda sensor's interface to CAN and point its frame and start bit at the field, so the reading comes with that sensor's calibration, operating window and P-codes instead of as a bare number on the bus. J1939 at 250 kbit with 29-bit ids — a third bit rate again, so it wants a bus of its own. PGN 65280, channel 1 on 0x0CFF0001 and channel 2 of an ALM-CAN-II on 0x0CFF0002. 10 ms. Lambda is SPN 520193: 2 bytes at J1939 start position 3-4, resolution 0.000244 per bit, which is 1/4096. READ THE ENDIANNESS TWICE: this field is set little-endian because that is the J1939 convention and Ecotrons publish the frame as J1939, but their own document never says so in words — if lambda reads as nonsense, clear Little Endian and the start bit becomes 23. The frame also carries O2%, sensor temperature (0.023438 K/bit) and a split 12-bit heater duty.
